title: Darrang
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Darrang district, in north-central Assam, is headquartered at Mangaldoi (Mangaldai), on the north bank of the Brahmaputra.

History

Darrang was a historic region under the Koch and Ahom kingdoms, and the name is linked to the old Darrang kingdom. Mangaldoi is said to be named after Mangaldai, a daughter of the Koch king.

Today

The district is agricultural — rice, jute and vegetables — and lies near Orang National Park, known for rhinos and tigers, on the Brahmaputra's north bank.
